Subject: Pilot MAP — exchanging testcases & prompt packs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the latency numbers look promising. We're ready to move to a short pilot but we need a scoped mutual action plan that covers: sample prompt packs, a small set of test cases (50–100), and clear usage constraints (no redistribution, ephemeral sandbox only).

High-level asks: 
- Access to a promptpack sample for internal evaluation (read-only)
- A manifest of testcases and expected labels
- A 3-week timebox for the pilot (ingress -> eval -> feedback)
- Minimal legal terms for sample exchange (NDA + limited use)

Can your team share a MAP draft and the artifacts we can pull into our QA environment? If you can propose dates, that would be great — Sam (cc) will help coordinate engineering.

Best,
Emma Chen
Senior Product Manager
BrightRetail

Emma / team — looping in Redwood Legal Ops. A few constraints we include on all ephemeral sample exchanges: 

• Purpose-limited license: samples are provided solely for evaluation of Redwood's inference pipeline; no productization or redistribution.
• Retention window: BrightRetail must delete samples from non-ephemeral storage within 30 days of pilot end.
• Access control: require named recipients; no public sharing.
• Auditability: we will keep a simple access log; please confirm your preferred contact for audit queries.

Attached: a short NDA (already countersigned) and a draft MAP that maps deliverables to dates. We've redacted any production PII from the sample prompt pack.

If BrightRetail wants additional protections (e.g., designated sandbox token, IP carveouts), flag them and we can add language to the MAP.

—Kimberly Park
Director, Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference

2) Data steward: Sam Patel will be the named approver (sam.patel@brightretail.com).
